Native text, colors and graphical dimensions are display projections; state label, current impairment sources and forecast segments have distinct roles. Wheel visibility uses retained state.incapacitation while segment sources recompute pain from current limbs/will. Actual canonical state update and replication timing must be compared before calling this divergence; no new defect asserted merely because an aggregate is retained.
